description: This file defines a Generator class responsible for orchestrating prompt-based model generation, handling asynchronous jobs, saving artifacts, and managing retries. It integrates various modules for flow control, logging, file system operations, and JSON extraction.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: A class that manages the generation process, including running prompts through models, handling output, retries, and saving results.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the generation process over prompts and models, managing progress reporting and collecting results.

methods.name: runJob
methods.description: Performs a single generation job with retries, returning the result or error.

methods.name: saveArtifacts
methods.description: Saves generated components and prompt details to the output directory.

methods.name: saveError
methods.description: Saves error details and output text when a generation fails.
